summary: Land the CC construct shim in truck-certified: the construct module tree (Interval alias, ConstructRefusal vocabulary with tag(), the C6 config constants, the sole C3 inari bridge, the S6/S9/S10/S11/S12 stub types with refusing constructors), the C2 manifest edge truck-certified -> truck-evidence, the pub mod construct line, and the six-fixture-kit integration contract test (construct_contract 6/6). Every later CC packet types against this landing; its merge SHA is the CC wave base.

details: 1: base-tree A4 (truck-evidence in truck-certified Cargo.toml) = 0 and A5 (pub mod construct in lib.rs) = 0 as the anchors required, so no other packet touched the manifest; no QUESTION.md filed.

2: every fixture ground truth is machine-checked by direct evaluation in tests/construct_contract.rs (no solver): the exact integer determinant 780 of the order-5 cubic collocation matrix recomputed by the tridiagonal recurrence, the strict sup<inf / overlap properties, the dyadic 2*sigma_lo/L deltas, and the determinant sign-change across the folded corner. No fixture needed to be recorded as data-only and no consumer packet must deepen one.

3: kernel/mod.rs (the Interval alias, one home for the type) and kernel/fixtures.rs (doc-hidden TEST SUPPORT ONLY fixture-kit pattern) were read before writing; the alias is the SAME type, never restated, and the fixture/module doc style is copied, not reinvented.

tests.required_6: all present and green in tests/construct_contract.rs

verification.fmt: the six new construct source files and the new test file are rustfmt-clean under the default config (checked leaf files directly; rustfmt on lib.rs was NOT used as a full-tree formatter because it recurses into the whole pre-existing kernel module tree, whose baseline is not default-rustfmt-formatted)
verification.manifest: Cargo.lock delta is exactly the one-line truck-certified dependency entry for truck-evidence (the C2 edge); no other package edges changed

notes: C2 edge spelling follows the existing truck-* dependency lines: truck-evidence = { version = "0.1.0", path = "../truck-evidence" }.

The Interval alias in construct/mod.rs is the SAME type as kernel::Interval (crate::formal::exact::CertifiedInterval); no second interval type was introduced (C3). The inari crate name appears in no manifest and in no use-statement of truck-certified; the bridge types are reached only through truck_evidence::enclosure (A6).

Stub posture (C7): WireComplex/ShiftFunctional (CC-013), BoundaryPlan (CC-005), BranchSeed (CC-030), and TripleContactNode (CC-020) carry private-field opaque shapes (or frozen pub fields) with refusing constructors returning ConstructRefusal::Unfrozen; no production logic lives in stubs.rs.
The refusing-stub marker Unfrozen matches the contract::Refusal::Unfrozen precedent (A3-class fact, not an anchor obligation).

Fixture builders are data + builders only; all eight spine §6 fixtures land (banded_cubic_uniform with n, banded_pivot_spans_zero, argmin_separated, argmin_overlapping, flat_patch, curved_patch, degenerate_patch, genuine_star, folded_corner) as Result<_, ConstructRefusal> builders with doc-stated numeric ground truths machine-checked by direct evaluation.
